description: This line plot illustrates the training loss over time for two models, “Vanilla” and “SepLLM,” as described in the paper “SepLLM Accelerate Large Language Models by Compressing One Segment into One Separator.” The x-axis represents “Training Time (s)” on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 250,000 seconds, with tick labels at intervals of 50,000. The y-axis represents “Loss,” also on a linear scale, ranging from 2.40 to 2.75. The “Vanilla” model is depicted by a purple line with triangle markers and a dashed line style, starting at a loss of approximately 2.75 and decreasing to about 2.50 by 250,000 seconds. The “SepLLM” model is shown by a red line with circular markers and a solid line style, beginning at a loss of approximately 2.75 and declining to about 2.48 by 250,000 seconds. A green dashed box highlights the region from 200,000 to 250,000 seconds, with an annotation indicating a 1.26x difference in loss between the two models at that point, where the “Vanilla” loss is approximately 2.52 and the “SepLLM” loss is approximately 2.48.
